wrap_module_for_activation_checkpointing: wrap a PyTorch nn.Module with activation checkpointing to reduce memory usage during training
unwrap_checkpointed_module: remove activation checkpointing from a module and its children by restoring the original forward method
pack_and_unpack_kwargs: flatten keyword arguments into a flat list and reconstruct them back to original args and kwargs
split_non_tensors_from_outputs: separate Torch Tensors from non-Tensor objects in a mixed tuple for autograd compatibility
review_CheckpointFunction_class: review the CheckpointFunction autograd class that supports activation checkpointing with non-Tensor outputs and CPU offloading
